What other options do you have that I could swap it to? I'd like to
consider those and then decide if I would like to swap or wait.
Note to the team: I'll pull his order and the live swap options before writing.

Hi Mike,

Here are the three I would put in front of you, with the exact difference against the $500 you paid for the KBuddy.

Magic Miner 40T at $799, so $299 more. That is 40 TH/s for about $20 per TH, which is inside the marker you gave me, and it is the best value per TH we sell. It is not in stock today, it's a pre-order that ships by Dec 14, 2026.

Bitfortun BS-4 (18 TH/s) at $599.99, so $99.99 more. Closest thing to the KBuddy in hashrate, and it ships from the manufacturer by Nov 30, 2026. Worth knowing it works out around $33 per TH, so it is a sideways move rather than a step up.

Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10 TH/s) at $379. That one is in stock and ships within 2 business days, and it would leave $121 back to you as store credit on your account. It is less machine than the KBuddy, so I only mention it as the option that gets hardware to you now.

If you go for the 40T or the BS-4, the difference is invoiced to you and it ships once that is paid. Either way the Harlo OS Diagnostics stays on the order and goes in the same box.

Waiting is a real option too. The K. is paid, reserved for you, and still set for December 1. Just reply with which way you want to go and I will make the change the same day.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Thanks, I'll take the Bitfortun BS-4.
